title: [ingest] tests/conftest.py globally monkeypatches sphinx.locale.init_console to a no-op
summary: At module load time, the project conftest replaces `sphinx.locale.init_console` with a stub that returns `NullTranslations()` and never touches locale state. This is intentional: CLI-path tests were breaking due to locale initialization side effects. Extension test suites that call `init_console` directly will get a no-op in the test environment.
